description: Agent Vendors: submit the quote or order in front of the agent and the vendor’s terms: the quote with its id, price, currency, days to delivery, days to ask for a refund, renewal (none, manual or automatic) and commitment in months; and the terms with where they came from, their version, when they were read, the same six points as the terms set them and their text, read for wording that overrides a quote such as prices subject to change, these terms prevail or quotes are not binding, wording that refuses refunds such as all sales final and wording that renews on its own. The signed report gives the quote, the terms with any overriding clause, each point with what was quoted, what the terms set and its status as match, contradicts, terms_better, terms_silent, not_quoted or unread, and counts the points compared, matching, contradicted, better for the buyer and left unstated, and names terms that contradict the quote: a higher price, another currency, slower delivery, a shorter refund window, a more automatic renewal or a longer commitment than quoted, a clause that lets the terms override the quote, a clause refusing the refund the quote offers and a clause renewing what was quoted as one-off; then quoted points the terms do not state, a renewal or commitment the quote never mentioned and terms with no source, with the fix for each. Each contradiction is named where it costs money. This reads one vendor’s terms against the quote before the spend: purchases already made checked against their governing terms are wever_terms-match-check, two versions of the same terms are wever_terms-change-check, which clauses a terms page holds is wever_terms-evidence-check and who pays when an agent errs is wever_liability-terms-check. Verdict terms_contradict_quote, terms_match_partial, terms_unexamined or terms_match_quote. POST /api/vendor-terms-match-check. Reads only the recorded vendor material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no vendor is contacted, no quote is accepted, no order is placed and no spend is approved. Agent Vendors reads the seller on the other side of a spend before the agent commits: whether the vendor is who it claims to be, whether its quote and terms hold together, whether its price stays the same and what it costs to leave. It is not one service’s terms on their own (wever_service-terms-check reads one service’s terms by themselves; the vendor terms-match check reads a vendor’s terms against the specific quote or order in front of the agent, where a contradiction costs money), not pricing structure or fee evidence (wever_pricing-tier-check and wever_fee-evidence-check; the vendor price check reads whether the price this vendor quoted this buyer stays consistent across the quote, the listing and any invoice or prior charge), not single promise types (wever_warranty-check and wever_shipping-check; the vendor delivery and refund checks read the whole delivery promise and the whole remedy path for one vendor engagement), not listing accuracy (wever_catalog-listing-check reads whether a catalog listing is accurate; a directory or marketplace listing being present is not vendor verification, and no vendor check treats listing presence as identity evidence), not after the payment (wever_purchase-record-check and wever_double-charge-check run after a payment; the vendor checks run before the spend, while walking away is still free), not the buyer’s own permission (wever_spending-policy-check and wever_authority-scope-check read the buyer’s permission to spend; the vendor checks read the seller on the other side of the spend: permission is not diligence, and diligence is not permission), not a promise once made (the wever_commitment checks; a vendor engagement becomes a commitment only after the agent accepts it, and the vendor checks guard the moment before that) and not an objective (the wever_goal checks read the objective the work serves; a vendor check reads a counterparty, not an objective). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-vendors-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-vendors/.
